## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Schema/design
- [ ] Synthetic example
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Implementation
- [ ] Workflow or dependency configuration

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant checks pass locally or are not yet applicable.
- [ ] The change does not claim production readiness without evidence.
- [ ] Sources, warnings, and uncertainty remain visible where relevant.

## Public-data and security checklist

- [ ] No customer, employer, equipment, recipe, process, or private-platform information is included.
- [ ] No real fab logs or unredacted screenshots are included.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, cookies, passwords, private keys, webhooks, or real `.env` files are included.
- [ ] I read `SECURITY.md`.
